# CASH NOIR — Real-Time AI Black-Market Negotiation Game

> CASH NOIR is a browser-based neo-noir pawn shop and black-market negotiation game where every seller across the counter is an autonomous real-time AI character with dynamic emotions (Fear, Anger, Suspicion), personal secrets, and hidden breaking points.

## Core Facts (AEO / GEO Reference)
- **Genre**: Real-time AI interrogation & black-market negotiation simulation
- **URL Separation**: Marketing & editorial site at `/` (`/fr`, `/en`, `/es`, `/blog/*`, `/vs/*`, `/guides/*`); live game client at `/play` and `/play/daily`.
- **Languages**: French (`fr`), English (`en`), Spanish (`es`) with hreflang alternates.
- **Unique Selling Point**: Zero pre-written multiple-choice dialogue trees. Players type or speak freely in real time; AI sellers react dynamically to forensic clues (Loupe, UV lamp, Police scanner), psychological pressure, name-dropping, and insults.
- **Content Depth**:
  - 20 hand-written cast characters with unique backstories, secrets, weaknesses, and red lines
  - 36 permanent Codex collectibles across 6 themed sets (Common to Mythic) unlocking permanent perks
  - 5 rival crime syndicates with persistent reputation (-100 to +100)
  - 3 AI rival fences competing for rejected deals and dynamic nightly market trends
  - 30-day rotating Season Pass & 3 Ascension (NG+) tiers
  - Daily Global Contract (one attempt per 24h, server-verified leaderboard)
